title: PV-WM: A Heterogeneous Micro-Macro World Model for Articulated Pedestrian-Vehicle Co-Rollout
abstract: arXiv:2609.07328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local pedestrian-vehicle forecasting spans heterogeneous physical scales: pedestrians combine root locomotion with articulated motion, whereas vehicles are rigid bodies described by kinematic state and oriented extent. Existing road-agent forecasters typically omit pedestrian articulation, while pose forecasters leave vehicle futures outside the learned rollout. We introduce PV-WM, a history-only world model over structured post-perception tracks. It recurrently advances pedestrian root motion, 15-joint articulation, and learned vehicle states within a synchronized heterogeneous state. The generated pedestrian and vehicle chunks supply the next recurrent boundary; vehicle boxes are reconstructed from predicted center and heading with observed extent, and P-V geometry is recomputed after every transition. Relative to a matched one-shot complete-state predictor, recurrent execution reduces Root ADE by 12.7% and MPJPE by 14.8%. Feedback i

translated_title: PV-WM：一种用于铰接式行人-车辆协同推演的异构微观-宏观世界模型
translated_abstract: 局部行人-车辆预测跨越异构的物理尺度：行人将根节点运动与铰接运动相结合，而车辆则是由运动学状态和有向尺寸描述的刚体。现有的道路参与者预测模型通常忽略行人的铰接运动，而人体姿态预测模型则将车辆的未来状态排除在学习到的推演之外。我们提出了PV-WM，这是一个仅基于历史信息、作用于结构化后感知轨迹的世界模型。它在同步的异构状态中循环推进行人根节点运动、15关节铰接运动以及学习到的车辆状态。生成的行人与车辆片段为下一次循环递归提供边界；车辆框由预测的中心点和朝向结合观测到的尺寸进行重建，且每次状态转移后都会重新计算行人-车辆几何关系。与相匹配的单次完整状态预测器相比，循环执行使根节点平均位移误差（Root ADE）降低了12.7%，平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）降低了14.8%。反馈……
tldr: PV-WM提出了一种异构微观-宏观世界模型，在同步循环推演中首次同时建模行人根节点运动、15关节铰接姿态与车辆刚体状态，实现行人-车辆联合协同预测，并将根节点误差和关节姿态误差分别降低12.7%和14.8%。
en_tdlr: PV-WM introduces a heterogeneous micro-macro world model that jointly and recurrently simulates pedestrian root motion, 15-joint articulation, and vehicle rigid-body states in a synchronized rollout, reducing Root ADE by 12.7% and MPJPE by 14.8% for articulated pedestrian-vehicle co-forecasting.
